batch_experiment.inclusive_cost: epoch preparation plus the sum of nonce-attempt timings divided by batch size

limitations: the access trace is collected with the full scratchpad
LRU misses are simulations and do not produce a valid PoW with reduced memory
dynamic traces are not known before executing their value-dependent addresses
shared runners do not measure hardware occupancy, power, temperature, or memory traffic
sequential batches do not model optimized parallel mining hardware
